Daily Check-In

One minute. Five signals.

Sleep, stress, mood, digestion, and nutrition quality give CCC the signals it needs to show how your body is responding.

Sleep shows recovery debt.
Stress predicts cravings.
Mood reveals consistency risk.
Digestion shows food response.
Nutrition quality drives energy.

Sleep

Poor sleep lowers readiness before motivation notices.

CCC helps users see recovery debt early, before cravings and fatigue take over.

Stress

Stress changes decisions before it changes weight.

When stress rises, cravings and poor choices usually follow. CCC makes that pattern visible.

Nutrition Quality

This is not calorie obsession.

CCC focuses on food quality, consistency, energy, digestion, and recovery signals.

Recovery

One bad day is data — not defeat.

CCC helps users recover quickly after cheat days instead of spiraling or quitting.
